documents.title: Listing Approval From BSE Limited & National Stock Exchange Of India Limited For 15,01,434 Equity Shares Of Rs 2/- Each Under Preferential Basis.
Fixation Of Book Closure Dates For The 41St AGM

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported Q1 FY27 turnover exceeding 700 crores, driven by strong realisations despite initial trade route disruptions in April and May. Management highlighted an EBITDA margin of 5.43% and a PAT of 20 crores, alongside progress in value-added product expansion and corporate restructuring involving Tieramet Limited. The company targets 12-15% volume growth for the full year and maintains a long-term revenue aspiration of 5,000 crores by FY30. Bhagyanagar India Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting strong financial performance with an increase in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT compared to the previous year. The company detailed ongoing corporate restructuring involving the amalgamation of BCPL and demerger of the copper business into Tieramet Ltd, alongside a preferential fund raise of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth of 12% to 15% for the full year.
guidance.quote: So, | think we should be looking at between 12% to 15% growth in terms of volume for the whole year now.

guidance.claim: The company guides to maintain EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5% for the rest of the year.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: Management estimates export contribution to be between 12% and 15% for the year.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of achieving 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: Management targets a 25% CAGR top-line growth over the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: Management expects to maintain a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

demand_outlook.claim: Secondary copper demand is expected to double in the next five years from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: Out of this, if you look at the secondary copper demand, it is expected to double in the next 5 years, from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: India is projected to consume around 2.4 million metric tons of copper by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: As we can see, India is actually one of the fastest growing copper users in the world, with around 2.4 million metric tons projected to be consumed in India by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that everything has normalized from the month of June.
demand_outlook.quote: Now, from June, it has become a normal scenario.

demand_outlook.claim: The recycled copper market is estimated to grow in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycled copper market, by some estimates, should be growing in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.

demand_outlook.claim: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Global copper consumption is predicted to reach 50 million tonnes by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has finished adding its capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

capex_expansion.claim: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years (FY27 and FY28).
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: A capacity expansion from 35,000 to 45,000 tons has been projected for next financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: So, this has been projected for the next financial year. The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year. From 35,000 to 45,000 tons.

margins_costs.claim: Disruptions in the first two months created nationwide shortages, allowing better realizations.
margins_costs.quote: Like | said, the disruption in the first two months created a shortage throughout the country and we could take advantage of the shortage. For whatever material we had, we could get much better realizations.

margins_costs.claim: Purchases of raw materials range from 86% to 95% of LME depending on scrap quality.
margins_costs.quote: So, our purchases would range from, you know, 86% to 95% of LME, depending on the quality of the scrap and our sales are also more or less linked to LME.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an operational EBITDA of over 100 crores and crossed 50 crores in PAT for the first time.
margins_costs.quote: For the first time in our history, we've also got an operational EBITDA of over 100 crores, and for the first time, we have crossed 50 crores in PAT.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards.

margins_costs.claim: In quarter four, the company achieved around 62 rupees per kg in EBITDA.
margins_costs.quote: With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes for the quarter came down to 5,200 tons, with 2,200 tons coming in June.
orders_capacity.quote: However, for the whole quarter, our volume has come down to 5,200 tons. But the good part of this is that 2,200 tons of the 5,200 tons has come only in the month of June.

orders_capacity.claim: The share of value-added products sold this quarter reached 63%.
orders_capacity.quote: We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's installed capacity reached 35,000 metric tonnes this year.
orders_capacity.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper sales volume increased by 34% to 24,000 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The company finalized the first round of fund raising at 52 crores, expected in August.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

capital_allocation.claim: Projected debt in 2030 is estimated around 325 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: The projection is showing that around 325 crores will be the debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The company announced a total fund raise of Rs. 52.25 Crores through preferential allotment.
Total equity increased from retained earnings without dilution.
capital_allocation.quote: And this increase in equity was not done through dilution, this was all done through retained earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital increased from 157 crores to 230 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: In the first two months, trade routes were disrupted and material was short across the country.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: A GST demand of 17 crores has been levied due to retrospective cancellation of a supplier's registration.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because of the retrospective cancellation of the registration of the supplier, the case has been put on us.

risks_headwinds.claim: Short-lead material from the Gulf has suddenly dried up due to disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to complete the corporate restructuring after the NCLT hearing scheduled on August 7th.
management_commitments.quote: Currently, the NCLT hearing is scheduled for the 7th of August, after which we should soon be able to complete this restructuring.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to execute 40 crores of capex across FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans a complete digital transformation of all processes, departments, and reporting over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: The company projects reaching 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: So, see, the copper prices are out of our control. At 15% volume growth, you can do the reverse math based on the copper prices to see when we achieve it. But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

management_commitments.claim: The government has mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content starting from FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Government has mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content (starting from FY28)

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a 25% CAGR for the next 3 to 4 years.
management_commitments.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
